fields.name: SpanParser primary-key span conversion family
fields.contract: SpanParser provides one in-place serialization and sequential deserialization family for delimiter-separated UTF-8 key values. Append writes a value at the caller's current buffer position, prefixes every noninitial value with ASCII '+', and returns the first unwritten position. Append accepts 12 types: Guid; signed and unsigned 64-, 32-, 16-, and 8-bit integers; decimal; string; and ReadOnlySpan<byte>. Guid values use 32 hexadecimal digits; numeric values use hexadecimal text; text and raw bytes substitute byte 0x1D for embedded '+'. Extract consumes the next '+'-delimited segment from a ReadOnlySpan<byte>, populates the requested type, and returns the unconsumed suffix. Extract supports 10 of Append's 12 types — the same list minus decimal and ReadOnlySpan<byte>, which Append can write into a key but Extract cannot read back out; the two halves are therefore not mirror images. GetDbGrainId<TModel> returns the IdSpan created for a non-null database model's generic type.
